'''Version 1.8.0''' was an update of the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on August 1st 2020.  It was 5.32 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

==== <u>General</u> ====

* The [[Evolution System#Functioning|merge system]] now is customizable
* Added the following config options:
*# Infected versions despawn
*# Primitive versions despawn
*# Ancient versions despawn
*# List of entities that will avoid the parasites
*# Vanilla mob Spawn Eggs
*# Infected Damage Cap
*# Primitive Damage Cap
*# Adapted Damage Cap
*# Ancient Damage Cap
*# Killcount goes up by time (only if difficulty is set to hard)
*# Mobs ignore sunlight when spawning
*# List of parasites that will break block in their way only if chasing its target
*# Spawnrate for the [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted versions]], [[:Category:Ancient Parasites|Ancients versions]], [[Stage I Beckon|Stage 1 Beckon]] and for the [[Vigilante]]
*# Number of days required for the parasites to spawn
*# Density for the particle effects spawned in the infested blocks
*# Maximum number of Beckons per dimension
*# [[Reinforcement System]] cooldown for spawning Beckons
*# Collective Attack for the Beckons (to reduce mob spawning when a lot are in the same area)
*# [[Primitive Yelloweye|Yelloweye]] gear degrade

* Removed the following config options:
*# [[Primitive Longarms|Shyco]] reflect Chance
*# Shyco reflect Damage
*# [[Primitive Longarms|Stage Adapted]] reflect Chance
*# Stage Adapted reflect Damage
*# Mobs with new task (renamed to: Mobs with new target task)

==== <u>Entities</u> ====

* New behavior: the parasites will start making groups:
** Tier I: [[Buglin|Buglins]], [[Rupter|Rupters]], Walking Heads
** Tier II: [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Infected Versions]]
** Tier III: [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive versions]], [[Heavy Carrier]]
** Tier IV: [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted versions]]
** Tier V: [[:Category:Ancient Parasites|Ancient versions]]
** Infected versions will recruit only Tier I - II parasites
** Primitive versions will recruit Tier I - III parasites
** Adapted versions will recruit Tier I - III parasites
** Ancient versions will recruit Tier I - IV parasites

* New effect for the Longarms branch, the less health they have, the more damage they will deal
*# Replacing the "reflect damage" one (to reflect this the mob will spawn particles, low health equals higher particle spawning)

* Increased flying speed/follow range for the Yelloweye branch
* New behavior: the following parasites will start running if needed:
*# Walking Heads
*# Infected Versions (minus Alafha)
*# Primitive versions (minus [[Primitive Yelloweye|Yelloweye]], [[Primitive Bolster|Bolster]])
*# Adapted versions (minus [[Adapted Yelloweye|Yelloweye]], [[Adapted Bolster|Bolster]])
*# [[Vigilante]]

* Parasites while chasing will no longer play ambient sounds
* Yelloweye projectiles will now reduce the equipped armor durability
* [[Moving Flesh]] will now avoid Players
* Tweaked flying parasites AI
* Reverted death animation for human, primitive and adapted versions
* New animations for the [[Primitive Summoner|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Summoner]] when summoning mobs
* New texture and base values for the [[Buglin]]
* New base values for the [[Heavy Carrier|Heavy]]/[[Flying Carrier]]

* [[Rupter]]:
*# -New model/texture/animation
*# -New base values
*# -Attacks will apply slowness
*# -Now they will convert zombies into Infected Humans

* [[Vigilante]]:
*# -New texture
*# -New animations
*# -New base values
*# -New behavior: if target is too far they will shoot otherwise they will go melee
*# -Changed behavior or their projectile (from an "egg" to a "fireball")

* [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Infected Versions]]:
*# -New models (minus [[Assimilated Big Spider|Dorpa]], Alafha)
*# -New textures (minus Dropa, Alafha)
*# -New animations (minus Alafha)
*# -New sound effects for all (minus Dorpa, Alafha):
*#* Human and villager will share the same sound effects
*#* [[Assimilated Pig|Pig]], [[Assimilated Cow|cow]], [[Assimilated Sheep|sheep]]<!--, pig-->, [[Assimilated Wolf|wolf]] will share the same sound effects
*# -New base values
*# -Added variant for [[Assimilated Big Spider|Big spider]]:
*#* It will spawn with 50% less health but will deal 25% more damage and apply poison on melee attack
*# -Changed death animation for the cow, sheep and wolf
*# -Changed "Infected Dorpa" to "Infected Big Spider"
*# -Reduced time to despawn for the web blocks spawned by the Big Spider
*# -Big spider will now shoot in burst of 3

* Walking heads:
*# -New models for all
*# -New textures for all
*# -New animations for all
*# -New sound effects for all
*# -New ability: they will jump at you from a longer distance
*# -New behavior: will avoid entities if they're alone or if the lightness around them is too high (like vanilla spiders)

* Primitive versions:
*# -New models and sound effects:
*#* [[Primitive Longarms]]
*#* [[Primitive Summoner]]
*#* [[Primitive Reeker]]
*# -New textures for all
*# -New animations for all
*# -New base values
*# -Tweaked hitbox size:
*#* Primitive Longarms
*#* Primitive Reeker
*# -Added variant for Reeker: It will spawn with 50% less health but will deal 50% more damage

* Adapted versions:
*# -New models:
*#* [[Adapted Longarms]]
*#* [[Adapted Reeker]]
*#* [[Adapted Manducater]]
*# -Tweaked [[Adapted Summoner|Summoner]] model
*# -New textures for all
*# -New animations for all
*# -New sound effects:
*#* Adapted Longarms
*#* Adapted Reeker
*#* Adapted Manducater
*#* Adapted Summoner (when summoning mobs)
*# -New base values
*# -Added variant for Longarms: It will spawn with 50% less health but will deal double damage
*# -Tweaked hitbox size:
*#* Adapted Longarms
*#* Adapted Reeker
*# -New behavior: they will start infesting nearby block by spawning infested Residue, this block will not despawn unlike ones spawned by the death of a Beckon
*# -Tweaked model for Summoner
*# -[[Adapted Yelloweye|Yelloweye]] projectile will do 2x duration and +1 amplifier (from its primitive version)
*# -Yelloweye will attack with melee now
*# -Yelloweye will shoot homming projectiles if the target is spending too much time in the air
*# -[[Adapted Bolster|Bolster]] will stretch out its limbs to have longer attack melee range

* Ancient versions:
*# -Tweaked models
*# -New textures for all
*# -Changed how the [[Dreadnaut]] fly
*# -New ability: will summon mobs by spawning Drop Pods
*# -New Dreadnaut mechanic: at 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% one of its longarms will drop
*# -Dreadnaut will shoot homming projectiles if the target is spending too much time in the air

* [[Reinforcement System]]:
*# -New textures for all
*# -New behavior: when not attacking, they will close up their limbs to reduce all incoming damage:
*#* [[Stage I Beckon|Stage I]] by 20%
*#* [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] by 40%
*#* [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III]] by 60%
*# -They will spawn now with their summon attack on cooldown

* New entities:
*# -New Infected version: '''[[Assimilated Villager|Infected Villager]]'''
*# -New Infected version: '''[[Assimilated Pig|Infected Pig]]'''
*# -New Walking Head: '''Infected Villager Head'''
*# -New Walking Head: '''Infected Pig Head'''
*# -New Reinforcement System mob: '''[[Sentry]]''': Turret-like parasite that shoots in burst of 3
*# -New Reinforcement System mob: '''[[Kyphosis]]''': Turret-like parasite who likes to smash the ground
*# -New Reinforcement System mob: '''[[Warden]]''': Big parasite built for territory defense purposes, they can jump to get closer to its target
*# -[[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Turret-like parasites]] will spawn on infested block [[Stage III Beckon|stage 3]]
*# -Big changes are planned to the infected Alafha and the [[Overlord|Ancient Overlord]], no changes for them at the moment

==== <u>Misc</u> ====

* Fixed crash caused by [[Assimilated Big Spider|Infected Dorpa]] web attack
* Fixed [[Buglin|Buglins]] trying to spawn a [[Rupter|Rupters]] when the Rupter is disable
* Changed the name for the following items:
*# "[[Longarms Armor Fragment|Shyco Armor Fragment]]" to "Longarms Armor fragment"
*# "[[Summoner Core|Canra Core]]" to "Summoner Core"
*# "[[Yelloweye Bone|Emana Bone]]" to "Yelloweye bone"
*# "[[Reeker Fang|Nogla Blade]]" to "Reeker Blade"
*# "[[Manducater Orb|Hull Orb]]" to "Manducater Orb"

* Changed [[Living Scythe|Living Sythe]] first person holding position
* Increased maximum input value for durability in the tools category
* Added NBT tags for the parasites:
*# "parasitekills"
*# "parasitedespawn"
*# "parasitetype"
